+"""Parse short human-readable durations into seconds."""
+
+import re
+
+_DURATION_RE = re.compile(r"^(?:(\d+)h)?(?:(\d+)m)?(?:(\d+)s)?$")
+
+
+def parse_duration(text: str) -> int:
+    match = _DURATION_RE.fullmatch(text)
+    if match is None or not any(match.groups()):
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid duration: {text!r}")
+    hours, minutes, seconds = (int(group) if group else 0 for group in match.groups())
+    return hours * 3600 + minutes * 60 + seconds

+"""Convert integers to Roman numerals (1-3999, subtractive notation)."""
+
+
+def to_roman(n: int) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(n, int) or isinstance(n, bool) or n < 1 or n > 3999:
+        raise ValueError("n must be an integer from 1 to 3999")
+
+    values = [
+        (1000, "M"),
+        (900, "CM"),
+        (500, "D"),
+        (400, "CD"),
+        (100, "C"),
+        (90, "XC"),
+        (50, "L"),
+        (40, "XL"),
+        (10, "X"),
+        (9, "IX"),
+        (5, "V"),
+        (4, "IV"),
+        (1, "I"),
+    ]
+    result = ""
+    for value, numeral in values:
+        while n >= value:
+            result += numeral
+            n -= value
+    return result
